sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet with project title, vicinity map, location map, index of drawings (12 total sheets), design team info, building data table, code information, asbestos/lead disclosure, and DIG notice. Building data shows existing vent building: construction type IIB, use group U (support facility), 2-story with basement. Floor areas: roadway level 5097 sf (existing, 0 renovated), first floor 9945 sf (existing, 3671 sf renovated), second floor 5325 sf (existing, 3809 sf renovated), roof 9945 sf (existing, 0 renovated). The generator support structure is not a 2-story building — it is a separate outdoor structure noted as 380 sf footprint per building data block. Generator floor elevation noted as +15.3 ft. Project date 01/23/2026 per drawing title block; REFINAL submittal 03/05/2026 per spec cover.

sheets.title: DOWNTOWN TUNNEL (NORFOLK) PUMP BUILDING SITE PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Site plan at 1"=10' scale. Shows existing building footprint, new generator enclosure location outside the ventilation support building, new underground electric, new generator on platform with concrete slab. Flood zone AE note embedded: 'THIS PROJECT IS LOCATED IN FLOOD ZONE AE AND IS IN A SEA LEVEL RISE INUNDATION AREA. BASE FLOOD ELEVATION = 8.00'. Generator floor elevation = 15.30 ft (high point of concrete slab +7.00; slab perimeter elevation = 6.75). Survey by Hoggard/Eure Associates. National Flood Hazard Layer FIRMette insert shown. Water storage and fuel fill cap shown on site plan.

sheets.title: GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Structural general notes, concrete notes, structural steel notes, and abbreviation legend. Key facts: generator is CAT 3512C model, total operating weight 115,000 lbs. Flood zone category AE; base flood elevation 8.0 ft; top of generator support frame set at +12.0 ft (allows for 4-ft freeboard above BFE of 8.0); generator floor elevation = +11.4 (U.O.N.). Seismic site class D. Design codes: ASCE 7-2022, ACI 318-2019, AISC 360-2016. Notes state structural observations not required per DEB. Structural engineer of record: Don Broyles, P.E. / Broyles and Associates, PC.

sheets.title: FOUNDATION PLAN AND ELEVATIONS
sheets.reading_notes: Foundation/framing plan at 1/4"=1'-0" and elevation at 1/4"=1'-0". Mat foundation: 2'-0" thick concrete mat, approx 34 ft (overall length) × 22.5 ft (with stair extending off side). Generator support frame: steel W8 and HSS4×4 columns, W8×31 beams, C12×20.7 stringers. Generator floor elevation = +15.3 ft. Bottom of concrete foundation = -12.0 ft (U.O.N.). Elevation view shows generator on elevated steel structure with fuel tank below; stair and landing for access. Weight of generator + enclosure + tank: 115,000 lbs. Foundation footprint approximately 34 ft × 11 ft (not including stair). Soil boring GB-1 data shown inset (GeoEnvironmental Resources, Inc. — project 110-7766).

sheets.title: ELEVATIONS AND DETAILS (TYPICAL DETAILS)
sheets.reading_notes: Braced frame elevation views (3/4"=1'-0") and connection details (1-1/2"=1'-0"). Shows X-bracing configuration in two bays. Key elevations: T.O. steel +12.0 ft; B.O. lowest horizontal member +11.4 ft; T.O. FDG. +6.75 (perimeter). Connection details include HSS4×4 columns to W8×31 beams with HSS3×3×3/8 horizontal braces; bolted connections; anchor bolts at base plates. Generator not shown in detail views for clarity per notes.

sheets.title: SECTIONS AND DETAILS (SECTIONS)
sheets.reading_notes: Section cuts through foundation at 3/4"=1'-0" showing concrete reinforcing details, stair framing, and base plate connection details. Generator floor elevation = +15.25 ft per section. Base flood elevation = 8.0 ft noted. Stair features: steel bar grating treads (galvanized), 1-bar grating, McMichols galv. vert riser panel. Handrail details per 2021 VCC. Stair design revised per phone conversation 3/5/2026 with Bill Pisa (DEB) — approved. HSS4×4 base plate details shown, W8×28 cap plate details shown.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: No single project square footage captured; two distinct structures in scope
conflict_flags.rationale: The project involves (1) selective demolition within the existing ~47,133 sf vent building and (2) a new ~400 sf outdoor generator support structure. These are fundamentally different scopes. DEB specifically flagged the confusion. For BFA pursuit purposes, the most relevant scope metric is the new generator pad (~400 sf) plus the electrical scope inside the existing building.
